We cut wood…not corners!

Carpenter and joiner, Tibshelf. Over 20 years in construction, from timber framing a house to fitting bespoke bedroom furniture.

Ask for a quoteSee the work
A deck and fitted wardrobes from Phil’s own gallery

From timber framing a house to bedroom furniture.

I’m a carpenter and joiner, and I’ve worked in the construction world for over 20 years. Over that time I’ve come across many different parts of the trade, so if it’s timber framing a house or fitting bespoke bedroom furniture, and everything in between, I can take it on.

I’m proud to be a member of the Trusted Trader scheme. I also worked with the BBC DIY SOS team on a local project as a volunteer.

Derbyshire Trusted TraderPhil’s certificate from Derbyshire County Council’s Trusted Trader scheme. His customers leave their comments on that profile.

The cut list.

The kinds of job in Phil’s gallery, with his own photos of each.

  • Fitted bedrooms

    Wardrobes, dressing tables and chests of drawers fitted into the room, and bedroom furniture made to suit.

  • Decking

    Timber decks with steps and balustrades, built out from the back of the house.

  • Staircases

    Newel posts, spindles and handrails for staircases and landings.

  • Gates and fencing

    Boarded garden and driveway gates, hung and braced.

  • Cupboards and alcoves

    Made-to-fit cupboards and alcove units, painted or stained.

  • Flooring

    Laminate laid through hallways and porches.
